metadata.description: Toolkit V2: the toolkit plugin, whose project-setup skill sets up and updates one solo developer's projects in Claude Code and Codex, and the workstreams plugin, a side panel for Claude Code that lists the work a project's chats are doing. The agent runs the project; the owner decides and steers.

plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: Sets up Toolkit V2 in a project, or moves a project from the older toolkit onto it: copies the model files, the chosen work tracking and memory skills, and their hooks.

plugins.name: workstreams
plugins.description: Shows the pieces of work this project's Claude chats report, the chat handling each one, and each chat's state, in a side panel. Open it with /streams. Claude Code only.
